scenarios.name: refund_discounted_sale_in_three_parts
scenarios.what: A discounted cash sale refunded one widget at a time: the discount comes back in proportion, the last part takes the rounding.

scenarios.name: refund_manual_item
scenarios.what: A sale with a manual item (no product): refunding it moves no stock.

scenarios.name: refund_partial_mpesa_sale_in_two_parts
scenarios.what: An M-Pesa sale of three widgets: one refunded and put back, then the other two refunded as damaged (not put back).

scenarios.name: refund_split_cash_and_mpesa_sale_with_discount
scenarios.what: A discounted sale paid partly in cash and the rest by an M-Pesa prompt: refunded one widget, then the other three; the discount and the cash share come back in proportion, to the cent.

scenarios.name: refund_split_cash_and_till_sale_with_discount
scenarios.what: A discounted sale paid partly in cash and the rest to the shop's own till (M-Pesa Till/Paybill): refunded one widget, then the other three; the discount and the cash share come back in proportion, to the cent.

scenarios.name: refund_whole_cash_sale
scenarios.what: A cash sale of two products, then the whole sale refunded and put back in stock.
